orientation.description: Picture side read CW270. Three broad top rows, separately serialized left and right columns, and two low closing rows extending from left toward the middle. Column attachment/order, crossed/overwritten signs, small humps, question roles and q/g remain unresolved. Dark-image overlap reduces legibility; ordinary date and print excluded. Hyphens only record visible stroke proposals, without proving word joins.
orientation.coordinate_convention: xyxy continuous image-edge coordinates. Native→CW90: (x,y)→(1175-y,x); native→CW270: (x,y)→(y,1785-x); native→CW180: (x,y)→(1785-x,1175-y). Bounds are broad whole-block context, not exact rows or physical bodies.
